# Schema proposal: adding Marine and Equipment categories to avas.parts (draft, not deployed)

**Status:** proposal only. Nothing here touches the live site or the repo.
**Draft data:** `marine/data-marine.js`, generated by `marine/build/gen_data_marine.py` from `marine/parts/*.csv` and `equipment/parts/*.csv`. Every part has `price: null` and `askPrice: true`.

## 1. Category picker (top level)
Add a `VERTICALS` list above the current bike `BRANDS`/`MODELS` flow:

| id | label | dv (to translate) | units word | model picker groups by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| bikes | Bikes | (existing) | bike | brand > model |
| outboards | Outboards | (needs translation) | engine | brand > hp band > model |
| marine_diesel | Marine diesel | (needs translation) | engine | brand > series > model |
| jetski | Jet skis | (needs translation) | ski | brand > model |
| generators | Generators | (needs translation) | set | brand > kVA band > engine model |
| pumps | Water pumps | (needs translation) | pump | brand > size > model |
| machinery | Heavy machinery | (needs translation) | machine | brand > class (t) > model |

The UI flow: pick a vertical → pick a model → see parts grouped by `cat`. The bikes flow stays exactly as it is. `vertical` defaults to `bikes` when it is missing, so `data.js` keeps working unchanged.

## 2. Model object (extends the current MODELS shape)
```js
{
  id: "yamaha-f250-f300-v6-4.2l-2010",
  vertical: "outboards",          // NEW
  brand: "Yamaha",
  model: "F250 / F300 V6 4.2L",
  name: "Yamaha F250/F300 V6 4.2L (2010+)",
  market: "?",                     // reuse MARKETS; '?' when not confirmed
  generation: "2010+",
  years: "2010+",
  size: "250-300 hp",              // NEW: replaces cc for non-bike (hp, kVA, tonnes, inch)
  seg: "outboard-v6",
  pop: 5,                          // 1-5 from fleet.csv rank
  catalogue_url: "...",            // first source page
  status: "sourced",
  note: "..."
}
```
- `cc` stays for bikes. Non-bike models use `size` (free text with units) and can add `hp`, `kva` or `tonnes` as numbers for filtering.
- `market` is mostly `?`, because the marine and equipment sources are US, AU or global catalogues.

## 3. Part object (unchanged fields; new category ids)
Same keys as today: `id, cat, name, oem, v, alts, fits[], tier, price, cost, stock, bin, rop, note, catalogue_name, priority, source_url, sources[], askPrice`.
- `oem`: the OEM number as printed. Yamaha uses `6CE-WS24A-00`, Yanmar `126650-35350`, Honda `78130-YB4-003`, Komatsu `600-319-3750`, CAT `1R-0739`, JCB `320/B4420`. **Keep slashes and dashes. Do not normalise them.**
- `alts`: aftermarket cross-references, such as an NGK code or a Fleetguard code. Fleetguard is Cummins' own brand, so for Cummins it also goes in `oem`.
- `confirmed: 'verify'` in the CSVs becomes `note` text plus `tier: "genuine-unverified"`, so the site can show "Number to be confirmed" and push the customer to WhatsApp.

New `cat` ids (with suggested names):

| cat id | name | used by |
|---|---|---|
| m_service | Service & filters | all marine |
| m_pump | Water pump / impeller | outboards, diesels |
| m_anode | Anodes | outboards, diesels, jet skis |
| m_ign | Plugs & ignition | outboards, jet skis |
| m_fuel | Fuel system | all |
| m_gasket | Gaskets & seals | all |
| m_prop | Propellers & hardware | outboards |
| m_jet | Jet pump (impeller, wear ring, grate) | jet skis |
| m_wear | Engine wear (rings, valves) | diesels |
| e_filter | Filters | generators, machinery |
| e_belt | Belts | generators, machinery |
| e_pumpend | Pump end (impeller, volute, seal) | pumps |
| e_kit | Service kits | machinery |
| e_fluid | Fluids | machinery |

## 4. Shared parts across models
Several numbers fit many models:
- The Yamaha 6CE filters fit the F225–F300.
- Komatsu 6736-51-5142 fits the PC200-7/-8.
- Fleetguard LF670 fits KTA19, VTA28, KTA38 and KTA50.

The generator merges rows by `oem` within a vertical into one part with several `fits`, the same way the bike data handles shared parts.

## 5. Search
Index `oem`, `alts` and `catalogue_name` alongside `name`. Marine and equipment buyers usually search by part number or by engine code (6HA2M, KTA19, PC200-8), so the model name, `size` and engine codes should also be searchable tokens.

## 6. What the site still needs before launch (not done)
- Pricing and supplier (all parts are currently askPrice).
- Dhivehi labels.
- Photos.
- Stock data.
- A frame/serial-number field on the enquiry form, because many marine rows depend on serial or variant.
